[18s] picked ""Light Out" at Midnight" — At 1:17 AM, the ALCS system reports a complete loss of airfield lighting control—runway and taxiway lights flicker and go dark. The AOC receives a garbled radio call from a ground crew reporting a 'random pattern' in the lights. As night operations continue, the pattern becomes erratic, suggesting a deliberate system manipulation.
